description: The demon fights, the warlock endures - power borrowed and paid for in flesh.

nodes.name: Improved Demon Armor
nodes.description: Increases the armor your Demon Armor grants by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0 'Improved Healthstone': 'Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 10%/20%.' HEALTHSTONES DO NOT EXIST - there is no item-creation system at all - so the node is retargeted onto Demon Armor, the Demonology defensive that does exist, keeping the 10%-per-rank shape. ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods, which for Demon Armor is its armor grant. It stacks with Demonic Aegis, as the real tree's two separate armour talents do.

nodes.name: Improved Imp
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the effect of your Imp's Firebolt, Blood Pact and Fire Shield by 10%/20%/30%.' Individual pet ABILITIES are not addressable - there is no per-pet-ability talent key - so it becomes general pet damage. First of six real demon talents that must land on the three live pet keys; see the module docstring.

nodes.name: Demonic Embrace
nodes.description: Increases your total Stamina by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim: 'Increases your total Stamina by 4%/7%/10%' - stepped in the real tree, flattened to 3% per rank, which lands within a point of the real total. stamina_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS: it is read off `bonuses` at character.py:1262 and DIVIDED BY 100, which is why a literal read-site probe finds nothing and the key is nonetheless LIVE. Authoring 0.03 would be a 0.03% bonus. This node is Demonic Knowledge's whole reason for working.

nodes.name: Fel Synergy
nodes.description: Your attacks heal you for 5% of the damage per rank as your demon feeds it back.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Your summoned demon heals you for 15%/30% of the damage you deal.' DEPARTURE ON THE SOURCE, which is forced: PETS NEVER FIRE PROCS - entities/pet.py contains no fire_proc_trigger at all - so nothing a demon does can be a trigger. Note the real talent's direction is already inverted (the demon heals YOU off YOUR damage), so this rides the warlock's own swings, the nearest real trigger. leech_pct is one of only three payloads that read the triggering hit's amount. 5% rather than 15% because a warlock swinging a staff is a last resort, not a rotation. CHANCE IS 50, NOT 100: only a proc's CHANCE scales with points, never its payload, so a 2-rank node at 100% would give rank 2 nothing - check_talent_balance.py caught exactly that in the first draft. 50 x 2 = 100 at full rank.

nodes.name: Improved Health Funnel
nodes.description: Increases the health your Health Funnel transfers by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 10%/20%.' warlock_health_funnel EXISTS, so this is one of the few Demonology nodes that needs no translation at all. USES _healing, not _potency or _damage - Health Funnel's content is a heal, and _damage here would be SILENT DEAD DATA, the mistake that left 18 talents dead across four classes.

nodes.name: Demonic Brutality
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Felguard's Cleave and the effect of Intercept.' The Felguard does not exist, pet_crit IS DEAD (measured on a live pet - no attribute moved), and there is no charge system for Intercept. All three halves blocked, so it becomes the one pet key that works. Second of six.

nodes.name: Fel Vitality
nodes.description: Increases your maximum health and your demon's health by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your maximum health and mana by 1%/2%/3%.' Mana is swapped for the demon's health, which is closer to Demonology's intent and uses pet_health. max_health_pct is a FRACTION (character.py:1411, NOT divided) while stamina_pct one tier up is POINTS - two health keys with opposite conventions, and audit_talents is the only thing that catches a mix-up.

nodes.name: Improved Succubus
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the effect of your Succubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss, and the duration of Seduction and Lesser Invisibility.' No per-pet-ability key, and there is NO STEALTH SYSTEM for the invisibility half. Third of six. (A first draft of this file invented 'Improved Voidwalker' here, which is a CLASSIC talent, not a WotLK one - the reference is now read rather than recalled.)

nodes.name: Soul Link
nodes.description: Your demon shares your pain - you take 10% less damage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, the signature Demonology talent: '20% of all damage you take is instead taken by your demon.' DEPARTURE - there is NO DAMAGE REDIRECTION and no threat transfer in this engine, confirmed by probe rather than assumed. What a player feels is that they take less, so it is straight mitigation at 10%. The real 'while your demon lives' clause is NOT enforced and is deliberately left out of the description too, because nothing reads a live pet count - stating it would be a lie in the tooltip. BARE damage_taken_pct is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES, so -0.10 is 10%; this is the key that was authored as 5.0 in Warrior Death Wish and meant 500%.

nodes.name: Fel Domination
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your demon summons by 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summoning spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.' DEPARTURE - there is no next-cast-modifier mechanic at all (no cast counter, no streak, no accumulator), so the emergency resummon the talent exists FOR becomes a shorter cooldown on all four. _cooldown is FLAT turns and talented_cooldown clamps at 1.

nodes.name: Demonic Aegis
nodes.description: Increases the armor your Demon Armor grants by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim for the one armour spell we have: 'Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Armor and Fel Armor spells by 10%/20%/30%.' Fel Armor does not exist.

nodes.name: Unholy Power
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks by 4%-20%.' This is the one demon talent whose real text IS general pet damage, so it needs no translation at all. Fourth of six.

nodes.name: Master Summoner
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your demon summons by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Reduces the casting time of your summoning spells by 2/4 sec and the Mana cost by 20%/40%.' No cast times, so only the mana half survives, at 10% per rank rather than 20% because summoning is a one-off rather than a rotational cost. _cost_pct is a FRACTION and POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION - the opposite sign to every other _pct key in the file. Mana Feed and Master Conjuror, the other two real talents on these rows, are DROPPED: demons have no resource, and Firestone and Spellstone are items in a game with no item-creation system.

nodes.name: Master Demonologist
nodes.description: You and your demon grow together - 2% more demon damage and 1% less damage taken per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Grants both you and your summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active' - a DIFFERENT effect per demon (Imp grants fire damage, Voidwalker threat and mitigation, Succubus damage, Felhunter resistances). NOTHING BRANCHES ON WHICH PET IS ACTIVE in this engine, so the five variants collapse into the two things common to all of them: the demon hits harder and the warlock takes less. Fifth of six. This talent was MISSING ENTIRELY from the first draft of this file, which is why the reference is now read first.

nodes.name: Molten Core
nodes.description: Your Immolate and Corruption have a 5% chance per rank to raise your spell damage by 10% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your shadow and fire damage spells have a 6%-18% chance to increase your spell damage by 6% and reduce the cast time of Soul Fire.' KEPT AS A PROC because the real text IS proc-shaped - this is the Mage Arcane lesson, where flattening proc-shaped talents made the tree worse. Soul Fire does not exist, so only the spell-damage half lands, and the filter is the warlock's one fire dot and one shadow dot. The chance IS rank-scaled by the engine (capped at 100, only when max_points > 1) while the PAYLOAD IS NOT, which is the project's existing multi-rank proc idiom. NOTE the stat_mod is damage_dealt_pct in PERCENTAGE POINTS - spell_damage here would be SILENT DEAD DATA inside a status effect, which is the single most common bug class in this project.

nodes.name: Demonic Resilience
nodes.description: Reduces damage you take by 2% per rank and increases your demon's health by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6: 'Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 1%-3% and reduces all damage your summoned demon takes by 5%-15%.' crit_taken_reduction IS A DEAD TALENT KEY - measured, and the same dead key that was replaced in sun_cleric_blessings this session - so the player half becomes plain mitigation. There is no pet MITIGATION key either, so the demon half becomes pet_health, the same survivability by another route.

nodes.name: Demonic Empowerment
nodes.description: Your demon hits 8% harder and has 8% more health.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6: an ACTIVE ability granting your current demon a different buff depending on which demon it is - Imp gets haste, Voidwalker health, Succubus invisibility, Felguard a stun break. FOUR separate blockers: there is no warlock_demonic_empowerment ability to unlock, nothing branches on which pet is active, pet_haste is DEAD, and there is no stealth system. Reduced to a passive giving every demon the two things that do work. Sixth of six, and the most compromised node in the tree - it is a 1-point node doing a passive's job, which is honest about how little survived.

nodes.name: Demonic Knowledge
nodes.description: You gain spell power equal to 4% of your Stamina per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6: 'Increases your spell damage by an amount equal to 4%/8%/12% of the total of your active demon's Stamina plus Intellect.' THE DEMON'S stats cannot be read, but the WARLOCK's Stamina can, and Demonic Embrace at tier 0 of this same tree inflates it - so the talent's actual flavour, stamina becoming spell power, survives with the source swapped, and the real 4%-per-rank is kept exactly. CRITICAL CONVENTION: the *_from_*_pct family is a FRACTION READ AS A RAW MULTIPLIER (character.py:1551, gained = source * pct), so authoring 4 for '4%' would grant FOUR TIMES the warlock's Stamina as spell power. stamina is a valid conversion SOURCE and spell_power a valid TARGET (STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, character.py:18); stamina is NOT a valid target, so the reverse would silently do nothing.

nodes.name: Demonic Tactics
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank and your demon's damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7, built verbatim for the half that works: 'Increases melee and spell critical strike chance for you and your summoned demon by 1%-5%.' pet_crit IS DEAD - measured on a live pet, no attribute moved - so the demon's half becomes pet_damage. crit_chance is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Decimation
nodes.description: Your spells hit wounded targets 10% harder per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7: 'When your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate or Soul Fire hits a target at or below 35% health, the cast time of your next Soul Fire is reduced by 20%/40%.' Soul Fire and Incinerate do not exist and there are no cast times either way, so THE EXECUTE-RANGE CONDITION is what is kept - it is the talent's whole identity. low_health_damage_pct reads the TARGET's health with a DEFAULT 0.35 THRESHOLD, which is exactly the real talent's 35%, so low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored - the kit refuses that key outright because it is UNSCALED, SUMS across talents, and is SHARED with the actor-reading reduction key. These values are FRACTIONS and PER RANK: 0.15 on a 3-point node measured as 45% on a live rogue earlier this session.

nodes.name: Improved Demonic Tactics
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8: 'Increases your summoned demon's spell critical strike chance by an amount equal to 10%/20%/30% of your own.' TWO blockers: pet_crit is DEAD, and nothing computes one stat from another ON THE PET (the *_from_*_pct family lands on the CHARACTER only). Rather than make this a SEVENTH pet_damage node - the pile-up is already six talents deep and that is the documented risk in this tree - it becomes the warlock's own crit, which is at least the stat the real talent is about. Summon Felguard, the other row-8 talent, is DROPPED: no felguard ability exists.

nodes.name: Nemesis
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Metamorphosis by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8, built verbatim for the one ability we have: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Metamorphosis, Demonic Empowerment and Demon Charge by 10%/20%/30%.' Demon Charge does not exist and Demonic Empowerment is a passive here, so only Metamorphosis remains - which is fitting, since it makes this node the capstone's natural prerequisite. FLAT turns rather than _cooldown_pct because Metamorphosis is a long cooldown and the percentage form clamps at 0.90.

nodes.name: Demonic Pact
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 9: 'Your summoned demon grants you and your party spell power equal to 2%-10% of your own.' A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY - only a PARTY-TARGETED ABILITY can (abilities.py:2064) - so the party half is unbuildable and the raid-buff identity is lost. The self half is kept as direct spell damage rather than a conversion, because spell_power from spell_power is circular. A genuine loss, and one for the list of things a real party-buff talent channel would restore.

nodes.name: Metamorphosis
nodes.description: Teaches Metamorphosis, becoming the demon you command.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_metamorphosis, which is requires_talent. Already at its real row in the outgoing tree.
